afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KBOU 101136 AFDBOU Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Denver/Boulder CO 536 AM MDT Mon Aug 10 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - Very warm temperatures to continue today and Tuesday, then start to cool Wednesday and fall below normal Thursday. - Another round of high-based virga showers today. Wind gusts of30-45 mph are possible from the showers. - Slight chance for strong to severe

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Today through Friday...It will be another very warm day across the area. A slight increase in mid-level moisture will lead to slightly higher relative humidities and more clouds. Scattered high-based showers and isolated thunderstorms are expected this afternoon and early evening. Wind gusts of 25 to 35 mph will be common under and near the showers and storms.
